Convenience plot helpers for JoiNMe objects

plot_helpers.Rd

Convenience wrappers around the main plot() methods for JoiNMe fit and dynamic prediction objects.

longitudinal_plot(), survival_plot(), and cumhaz_plot() route to the corresponding fitted or predicted trajectory plot.

association_plot() exposes the fitted association-curve display for JoiNMeFit objects.

diagnostic_plot() exposes the scalar and running sampler diagnostics for JoiNMeFit objects.

mcmc_plot() applies bayesplot MCMC geometries to the renamed posterior draws returned by draws(), which means the displayed parameter labels are the same user-facing names used by summaries and diagnostics.

Usage

longitudinal_plot(object, ...)

survival_plot(object, ...)

cumhaz_plot(object, ...)

association_plot(object, ...)

diagnostic_plot(
  object,
  type = c("rhat", "ess_bulk", "ess_tail", "mcse_mean", "mcse_sd", "running_mean",
    "running_quantile"),
  ...
)

mcmc_plot(
  object,
  pars = NA,
  type = c("intervals", "areas", "dens", "dens_overlay", "hist", "trace", "violin",
    "acf", "rhat", "neff"),
  variable = NULL,
  regex = FALSE,
  fixed = FALSE,
  draws = NULL,
  seed = 1,
  ...
)

Arguments

object

A JoiNMeFit, JoiNMeFit, JoiNMeDynPred, or PredJoiNMeFit object as appropriate for the requested helper.

type

The requested diagnostic or bayesplot geometry.

pars

Deprecated alias of variable for mcmc_plot().

variable

Optional renamed posterior variable names for mcmc_plot().

regex

Logical; whether variable should be treated as a regular expression.

fixed

Deprecated logical alias controlling exact versus regular-expression matching when pars is supplied.

draws

Optional number of posterior draws to keep.

seed

Integer seed used when subsetting posterior draws.

...

Additional arguments forwarded to the corresponding plot() or bayesplot::mcmc_*() implementation.

Value

For the plot helpers, a ggplot object, a combined plot object, or a named list of plots depending on the requested object and plot family.
